written: 2026-11-25, before any Phase 16 real-athlete statistic and before the synthetic held-out run

launch_definition.kinematics: Phase 15 / skill_drills.kinematics: Savitzky-Golay order 2, window 7 (sensitivity 5, 9) on x, y at 10 Hz; speed = |v| from the SG derivative; a_t = numpy.gradient(speed, 0.1)
launch_definition.onset: first frame index with SG speed > 1.0 yd/s
reject_if: SG speed at frame 0 > 1.0 yd/s (onset before recording)
onset + 10 > last frame (1.0-s window not fully observed)
launch_definition.window: frames onset .. onset+10 inclusive (t_onset to t_onset + 1.0 s)
launch_definition.primary: 95th percentile (numpy linear interpolation) of a_t over the window
launch_definition.identity: route (original drill_name; SPEED_OUT_LEFT kept separate), draft year, route x year cell
launch_definition.routes: the 13 Phase 15 route labels (12 route families); GAUNTLET and CIRCUS excluded
launch_definition.forty_reference: identical definition applied to every Combine FORTY_YARD_DASH attempt of the WR (same onset, window, percentile); athlete value = mean over valid attempts; test-retest over the first two valid attempts

synthetic_acceptance.rule: If any criterion fails in either calibrated scenario, no athlete-level claim is made (stopping condition).

definitions.onset_error: estimated onset frame time minus true continuous time of first true speed > 1 yd/s
definitions.launch_truth_primary: launch_p95_trend: 95th percentile of the step-free propulsive acceleration on the same 11-instant grid from the TRUE onset (the instantaneous a_t including 3.5-4.5 Hz step oscillation is reported as a secondary truth; 10 Hz smoothing cannot resolve it)
definitions.launch_measurement_reliability: var(truth) / (var(truth) + var(estimate - truth)) per trial, after removing mean bias (trial level)
definitions.spearman_vs_true_athlete_A0: athlete level: mean of the estimates over 10 synthetic routes (independent trials, effort kappa 0.75-0.95 per trial) vs the athlete's A0; athlete A0 ~ N(8.0, 8% CV)

synthetic_acceptance.note: Definitions fixed after a single dev-seed smoke test (seed 101, design only) showed the instantaneous estimand is unresolvable at 10 Hz; no held-out data and no real-athlete statistic had been computed.

amendment_after_dev_before_holdout.observed_on_dev: window 7: onset error median +0.040 s; launch relative bias -0.116 (SD 0.026); trial reliability 0.90; athlete-level Spearman with A0 0.96
amendment_after_dev_before_holdout.amendment: Criteria values are NOT changed. Interpretation is split: (a) onset, reliability, athlete-rank and failure criteria gate any athlete-level (relative, rank or variance-component) comparison; (b) the bias criterion gates only absolute-magnitude statements (yd/s^2). If (b) fails, launch values are reported as relative scores only.
amendment_after_dev_before_holdout.disclosure: This split was written after seeing dev results; it is reported as a deviation in the Phase 16 report.

redundancy.athlete_score: athlete mean of route-year-standardised (z) launch p95 over valid routes (raw cell-centred version reported too)
redundancy.variance_components_model: REML: z_launch ~ route x year cell (fixed) + standardised athlete-level sprint references (fixed) + athlete + athlete x route + residual; reduction of athlete variance vs the model without references
redundancy.close_if_redundant: athlete-variance share explained by the sprint references >= 0.70 (point estimate)
redundancy.too_unreliable_if: residual generalizability G(10) < 0.50 (point) or its bootstrap 95% lower bound < 0.30
redundancy.otherwise: CONDITIONAL GO: recommend (not conduct) a new pre-registration with one WR outcome

year_analysis.harmonised_routes: routes present in all three draft years under the same name: COMEBACK, CURL, DAGGER, GO, OVER_SHOULDER_ADJUST, POST_CORNER_ROUTE_RIGHT, RED_ZONE_FADE, SLANT, SLOT_SAIL, SLOT_STRIKE
